content: {"reasoning":"The retroactive authorization window is closed, and Meridian does not offer peer-to-peer review, so neither route is available. A formal appeal is still permitted because CO-197 is on the table, and similar claims were paid after appeal in 9 of 24 cases, while resubmission with records paid 0 of 1. The payer path is therefore not exhausted, and billing the patient or writing off would be premature.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
